GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 387.1 (12 Oct 45) CIS
(SCAPIN-144)
APO 500
15 October 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Amnesties.
This Headquarters has no objection to the granting of the amnesties by the Imperial Japanese Government as proposed in Central Liaison Office Memorandum No. 233 to the Office of the Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, dated 12 October 1945, Subject, Amnesties, and as discussed by representative of Central Liaison Office with Brigadier General E. R. Thorpe, this Headquarters, on 13 October 1945.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
/s/ H.W. Allen,
/t/ H.W. ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
